Overview.TotalSupplyTooltip: All tokens currently held in wallets, including the void address. Contract-burned tokens are already excluded from this number.
Overview.ContractBurnTooltip: Tokens burned through the on-chain burn contract. If the asset has minting enabled, this amount can be minted again, unlike tokens sent to the void address.
Overview.VoidTooltip: Amount held by the void address. These tokens are permanently out of circulation and are excluded from the circulating supply shown on this page.
Overview.CirculatingSupplyTooltip: Tokens currently in circulation. Equals the total supply minus the tokens held by the void address.
